validate: too long for one fact: Under the Distributor Agreement between Peregrine/Bridge Transfer Corporation and NEON Systems, the indemnified party may employ separate counsel and participate in the defense, but the fees and expenses of that counsel are not at the indemnifying party's expense if the indemnifying party has assumed the defense with counsel reasonably satisfactory to the indemnified party; provided that the indemnified party's counsel fees are at the indemnifying party's expense if the employment of that counsel was specifically authorized in writing by the indemnifying party, or the indemnified party was advised by counsel that there is a conflict of interest or issue conflict in the representation by the indemnifying party's counsel, or that there may be legal defenses available to the indemnified party that are not available to the indemnifying party (in which case the indemnifying party may not assume the defense).

Under the Distributor Agreement between Peregrine/Bridge Transfer Corporation and NEON Systems, if the Licensee is prevented from its normal use of any Licensed Product or Documentation by injunction or court order arising from alleged or actual infringement of a third party's intellectual property rights relating to any Licensed Product or Documentation, then the Licensor, at its option, in addition to the other remedies in the Distributor Agreement and at no expense, loss or damage to the Licensee, must (a) replace the infringing Licensed Product or Documentation free of infringement, (b) modify it so it is free of infringement, or (c) procure for the Licensee, by license or other release of the infringement claim, the right to make Sublicense Copies and copies of the Documentation to meet the demand of Redistributors and Customers and to market and sublicense Sublicense Copies and copies of the Documentation.
decision_floors.grounded: Under the Distributor Agreement between Peregrine/Bridge Transfer Corporation and Neon Systems, Inc., a "Redistributor" means any individual or entity that is granted a license by Neon Systems, Inc. to copy and sublicense one or more Licensed Products to Customers.

Under the Distributor Agreement between Peregrine/Bridge Transfer Corporation and NEON Systems, during the term of the agreement and the five-year period immediately following its termination, Licensee has the right, at its own expense, to audit and examine Licensor's records concerning Licensor's compliance with its confidentiality obligations under the agreement.

Under the First Amendment to the Distributor Agreement between Peregrine/Bridge and NEON Systems, upon the expiration or any termination of the Distributor Agreement, Peregrine/Bridge Transfer Corporation shall repay to NEON Systems, Inc. the aggregate amount of all Royalty Advances then outstanding.

Under the Distributor Agreement between Peregrine/Bridge Transfer Corporation and NEON Systems, Inc., upon exercise of the option, NEON Systems, Inc. and Peregrine/Bridge Transfer Corporation or Skunkware, Inc. (as the case may be) shall diligently and in good faith negotiate and execute a definitive purchase and sale agreement for the acquisition of all of the assets of, or outstanding capital stock in, Peregrine/Bridge Transfer Corporation.

Under the Distributor Agreement between Peregrine/Bridge Transfer Corporation and NEON Systems, Inc., the definitive purchase and sale agreement shall provide that NEON Systems, Inc. may pay the purchase price in cash, in shares of its Common Stock, or in some combination thereof.
